paragraphs: I've contributed to complex data projects that require robust analysis, such as building a tool-calling LLM agent for a multi-omics cancer research platform, where I integrated three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation, and dataset provenance.
I also proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python for a Madrid-based product start-up client, showcasing the tool in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Power BI yet, which I believe would enhance my ability to visualize and present data effectively.
How can I walk you through my approach to contributing to complex data projects at Trainline, and how my experience aligns with your needs?
